title: Reversal of Adjudicated TRICARE Select Claim Lines
content:
**Policy text.** A reversal of a **TRICARE Select** claim line withdraws exactly the deductible, beneficiary liability and TRICARE payment of one adjudicated line, identified by that line's own record, and is posted only for one of the recognised reversal reasons (an overturned appeal, a duplicate claim, other health insurance found retroactively, a provider correction or catastrophic-cap reprocessing). The corrected adjudication is posted afterwards as a new line of the same claim with the next unused line number. The line being reversed has not already been reversed.

## What a reversal does

| Element | Reading |
|---|---|
| Object | one adjudicated line, named by its own record |
| Withdraws | that line's deductible, beneficiary liability and TRICARE payment, exactly |
| Reasons | overturned appeal; duplicate claim; other health insurance found retroactively; provider correction; catastrophic-cap reprocessing |
| Guard | the line has not already been reversed, as the claim-line records show |
| Afterwards | the corrected adjudication is a new line of the same claim, with the next unused line number |

## Hypothetical illustration

Claim lines 1 and 2 exist on a claim and line 2 is reversed for an overturned appeal. The reversal withdraws line 2's deductible, liability and payment; the corrected adjudication is posted as line 3 of the same claim. Line 2 cannot be reversed a second time.
